# Dimension Forge — 0D → 4D

## Canonical dimensional roles
- `0D / POINT`: identity, scalar, anchor, invariant, isolated point or source atom. No extension.
- `1D / EDGE`: ordered route, segment, ray, line, length, causal/path relation, one-parameter chain.
- `2D / FACE`: plane, area, polygon, table/map, planar relation, projected surface or graph layout.
- `3D / VOLUME`: cube, cuboid, cylinder, pyramid, sphere, spatial grid, voxel/volume or 3-axis frame.
- `4D / TESSERACT_CELL`: 4D coordinates, W-axis, time-indexed spatial state, homogeneous/4D transform when source supports that role, or an explicit 4D hypercube/cell.

A source may have secondary roles, but one `DIMENSION_PRIMARY` is required for each listed carrier. If a source speaks of 5D or nD without mathematical support, do not invent a physical extra dimension: classify the usable projection at 0D–4D and keep the higher-dimensional claim as `SOURCE_ONLY/OPEN`.

## Chisel / carving primitives
Construction with ruler and compass; vertex; curve; diagonal; angle; parallel; perpendicular; symmetry; similarity; congruence.

## Figures
0D: point.
1D: line, segment, ray, length.
2D: plane, area, polygon, triangle, altitude, hypotenuse, Pythagorean relation, parallelogram, square, rectangle, rhombus, rhomboid, quadrilateral, trapezoid, kite, circle, diameter, circumference.
3D: volume, cube, cuboid, circular cylinder, pyramid, sphere.
4D: tesseract, hypersphere and explicit 4D/nD projections.

## Forge contract
`SOURCE_LEDGER → DIMENSION_PRIMARY → GEOMETRY_BRANCH(ES) → CLEAN_PRIMITIVES → TYPED_RELATIONS → JAVA_VALIDATE → SPACE_STONE_BIND → READBACK`.

Never delete the authoritative source to make the projection cleaner. “Cut shell” means the shell does not enter CURRENT canonical geometry payload; source/history remains addressable unless the user separately names an exact deletion target and authorizes deletion.

# Java Tesseract Geometry Validator

The plugin contains a dependency-free Java 21 reference implementation under `java/`.

Validation rules:
- every carrier has one primary dimension 0..4;
- dimension monotonicity for tesseract construction: point→edge→face→volume→4D cell;
- stable source IDs are preserved in node metadata;
- secret carriers may be classified but must have `ingest=false`;
- cross-dimensional projection is explicit and never silently changes source identity.

Compile/run reference:
`javac -d out $(find src/main/java src/test/java -name '*.java') && java -ea -cp out ggdv.tesseract.geometry.GeometryCoreTest`.
